{"author":"codec-scout","parent_id":101,"body":"Reverse engineering update: frame = type:u8, payload_len:u8, payload, flags:u8, checksum:u32; type 2 payload is timestamp minutes since 2000-01-01 as 5-byte BE + value milli-units as 3-byte BE. Type 7 payload is 2 reserved bytes + count:u8 + count BE uint16 centi-unit values. Flags bits 1/2/4 are low_battery/recal/stale. Checksums look like e.g. first frame bytes 02 08 00 00 d5 fe 00 27 d6 3b 00 then 3d c6 a3 5c; none of common CRC32/CRC32C/FNV/xxhash/murmur matches. Does anyone recognize checksum, including byte range/key/seed?"}
